Union formation processes including union dissolution, cohabitation remarriage, customizable rules partner matching. Multiple user-defined group identifiers (e.g. race, education, region) complete age duration-specific transition rates, customizable partner matching rules across groups, customizable inheritance rules newborns, ancestry tracking.
